text:
Lisandro Martinez wants to leave Man Utd in the summer with Atletico Madrid interested - Paper Talk
Plus: Estevao Willian has told friends he is in a "crisis" at Chelsea; Maxence Lacroix is feared to be out until January; members of the Everton hierarchy were uneasy with bringing Jack Grealish back to the club
Friday 30 October 2026 22:21, UK
The top stories and transfer rumours from Saturday's newspapers...
PREMIER LEAGUE
Man Utd defender Lisandro Martinez wants to leave a club on a free in the summer with Atletico Madrid interested - The Sun
Man Utd players were booed on the train en route to London ahead of their game against Chelsea - The Mirror
Chelsea goalkeeper Emi Martinez has revealed his hand is permanently disfigured after refusing surgery for a broken finger he feared would force him to miss the World Cup - The Sun
Chelsea starlet Estevao Willian is said to be confused by his lack of minutes under Xabi Alonso and has told friends he is in a "crisis" - The Sun
Blues defender Maxence Lacroix is feared to be out of action until January with a hamstring injury - The Athletic

It has been revealed there was a sense of 'unease' among the Everton hierarchy in re-signing Jack Grealish in the wake of his unauthorised absence that saw him dropped for the Carabao Cup tie against Newcastle - The Times
EFL
Former Aberdeen boss Jimmy Thelin is on the radar to take the vacant position at Sheffield Wednesday - Daily Record
SCOTTISH FOOTBALL
Former Celtic recruitment chief Mark Lawwell has landed a new job at Chelsea - Scottish Sun
Former Celtic striker Pierre van Hooijdonk has been cleared by NAC Breda following an internal investigation into his son, Sydney's, January move to Portuguese side Estrela Amadora - Scottish Sun
WOMEN'S WORLD CUP
FIFA is to fall short of gender equality with the prize money on offer at next year's Women's World Cup - The Guardian
digest_he:
בלם מנצ'סטר יונייטד, ליסנדרו מרטינס, מעוניין לעזוב את המועדון כשחקן חופשי בקיץ הקרוב. על פי הדיווחים, קבוצת אתלטיקו מדריד הספרדית פוקחת עין על מצבו ועשויה לנסות לצרפו.

בגזרות אחרות בפרמייר ליג, חלוץ צ'לסי הצעיר אסטבאו וויליאן הביע בפני מקורביו תסכול מחוסר הדקות שהוא מקבל תחת המאמן צ'אבי אלונסו. בנוסף, באברטון התגלתה תחושת אי-נוחות מסוימת בקרב גורמים בהנהלה סביב החתמתו המחודשת של ג'ק גריליש, בעקבות היעדרות לא מאושרת שהובילה להדחתו מסגל הקבוצה לאחרונה.
